headline: Vegas, when we get to it. *Pick and mix*.
footer: Four of us. Nobody has picked a week yet, so everything below is still open.

paragraphs: This is a pile of things that looked fun, not a plan. Nothing is booked and nothing is decided. Some of it we might do all together, some in twos, some not at all, and that is the whole point of writing it down rather than agreeing an itinerary.
Prices are per person unless a card says otherwise, and they are roughly what to expect rather than a quote.

notes.lead: A week is a long time in Vegas.
notes.rest: The Strip wears thin well before the last day, which is why about a third of the cards below are an hour or more out of town.

notes.lead: Nothing on this list is a casino.
notes.rest: If a hotel without a slot floor appeals, Vdara and the Waldorf Astoria are both at CityCenter, non-gaming, non-smoking, and do two-bedroom suites.

notes.lead: Three stretches to avoid when we pick dates.
notes.rest: The National Finals Rodeo runs 3 to 12 December and Christmas week is busy and priced like it. CES takes the first full week of January and is worse than both.

notes.lead: Winter is the season for everything below.
notes.rest: December highs sit around 14°C and lows near 4°C, cold enough after dark to want a coat. July is 40°C and rules out most of the outdoor cards entirely.

sections.intro: Only relevant for whatever we actually feel like doing. Roughly in the order things stop being available.

items.label: "O"
items.detail: Holiday weeks fill up, and it does not run every night.

items.label: Helicopter
items.detail: Afternoon slots go first, and winter weather cancels.

items.label: Skydive
items.detail: Morning slots are the calm ones and the popular ones.

items.label: Battlefield Vegas
items.detail: Worth a phone call rather than a web booking, since only the two-person package is published.

items.label: Omega Mart, Neon Museum
items.detail: Both timed entry, and dusk goes first.

items.label: A car
items.detail: Needed for anything in the out-of-town section.

sections.caveat: Prices and schedules here were checked in August 2026 and none of it is booked. Worth confirming once we have dates, especially if we land on a public holiday, when opening hours across the city move.
